weighting: owned train targets; (count+1)^(-0.5), mean-one separately for category/modality/specifics presence; fixed candidate, not alpha experiment
loss: unchanged candidate: weighted CE means, element-mean BCE/MSE, sum modality means, latent-summed/event-mean KL; .3 posterior + beta KL + .1 prior; mean per-microbatch objectives
index: first admission by timestamp then hadm_id, selected before eligibility; never replace excluded index
eligibility: alive and still in selected encounter at admission+24h; death timing and conflicting mortality markers excluded explicitly
view: selected encounter only including linked pre-admission ED records; occurrence<=cutoff; observed availability retained but not a filter in diagnostic mode
landmark: one state at last retained event <= admission+24h, from final bounded context window; no pooling
gap_policy: recompute on retained view; every chunk's final next-gap zero with has_next_gap false; final zero is unknown, not observed zero
demographics: birth_year from patients anchor_year-anchor_age, numeric prefix; remaining five prefix slots explicitly Unknown/unconditioned, no text encoder
modalities: categorical hospital/ED boundaries and numeric ED heart rate only, no specifics targets; fixed source-defined bpm, no imputation/normalization/clipping
probe: StandardScaler and logistic regression fit train only; C chosen by validation log loss; freeze without train+val refit; test once; no class weighting
claim: reduced-modality occurrence-time engineering diagnostic; neither paper-exact nor strict prospective
deviations: two active event modalities, heart-rate-only numeric variable
no text specifics; five demographic attributes unconditioned
four optimizer steps, not converged pretraining
fixed original pilot architecture and declared candidate weighting/reductions
24h first-encounter mortality probe differs from paper zero-shot and landmark-CV experiments
